builds.hypothesis: E5 explosion150+0.8 AP magic; shield235+0.5 AP is separate. AP/penetration support detonation; shield power does not amplify explosion. Deathcap amplifies AP; Shadowflame supplies15 flat magic penetration/conditional lowHP magic-true amplification; Void supplies40% MR penetration; Banshee/Zhonya supply105 AP each; Riftmaker supplies HP-to-AP and verified8% combat ramp.

kitEvidence.formula:
Ivern grants [75 / 115 / 155 / 195 / 235 + (0.5) × AP] Shield to an ally champion or Daisy. After [2] seconds, it bursts, dealing [70 / 90 / 110 / 130 / 150 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage and Slowing enemies by [(0.4 / 0.45 / 0.5 / 0.55 / 0.6) × 100]% for [2] seconds.

If Triggerseed detonates and no enemy champions are hit while the shield still persists, the ally will be shielded for [75 / 115 / 155 / 195 / 235 + (0.5) × AP] for [2] seconds.
